parameters.query: SELECT dc.id, dc.name, dc.percent::float AS percent, dc.is_active, dc.sort_order, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM activities a WHERE a.discount_card_id = dc.id) AS uses FROM discount_cards dc ORDER BY dc.sort_order, lower(dc.name);

WITH upd AS (UPDATE discount_cards SET name = $2, percent = $3::numeric, is_active = $4::boolean WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id),
ins AS (INSERT INTO discount_cards (name, percent, is_active, sort_order)
        SELECT $2, $3::numeric, $4::boolean, COALESCE((SELECT max(sort_order) + 1 FROM discount_cards), 0) WHERE $1::int IS NULL RETURNING id)
SELECT id FROM upd UNION ALL SELECT id FROM ins;

parameters.query:
WITH tz AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT timezone FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1), 'UTC') AS z),
v AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.due_at, a.subject, a.price, a.discount_name, a.discount_percent, a.amount_paid, a.commission_percent, a.commission_amount,
         sm.id AS staff_id, sm.name AS staff_name, u.name AS owner_name, TRIM(CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name)) AS client
  FROM activities a
  JOIN staff_members sm ON sm.id = a.staff_id
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = sm.owner_user_id
  LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = a.contact_id, tz
  WHERE a.is_completed = true AND a.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND (a.due_at AT TIME ZONE tz.z)::date BETWEEN $1::date AND $2::date
    AND ($4::boolean OR sm.owner_user_id = $3::int)
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(s ORDER BY lower(s.staff_name)) FROM (
     SELECT staff_id, staff_name, max(owner_name) AS owner_name, count(*)::int AS visits,
            COALESCE(sum(amount_paid), 0)::float AS paid, COALESCE(sum(commission_amount), 0)::float AS commission
     FROM v GROUP BY staff_id, staff_name) s), '[]'::json) AS summary,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(x) ORDER BY x.due_at) FROM (
     SELECT id, due_at, subject, client, staff_id, staff_name, price::float AS price, discount_name, discount_percent::float AS discount_percent,
            amount_paid::float AS amount_paid, commission_percent::float AS commission_percent, commission_amount::float AS commission_amount FROM v) x), '[]'::json) AS visits;
